item.text: {"summary":"Draft is publishable after tightening support for the update and interval, but the resolver/target fields are coherent with the ledger contract.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The +0.25 momentum/breadth adjustment cites ex-gas/ex-auto breadth and gasoline/vehicle category effects, but the cited evidence summarized in the draft only supports total May/April prints and total levels.","actionRequested":"Either add the specific Census table/category evidence supporting ex-gas, ex-auto, gasoline, and motor-vehicle claims, or reduce/rephrase the adjustment as a judgmental persistence/momentum update from the total-series prints only."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The 80% interval is based on realized volatility from only three monthly observations, including one 2025 value computed from current-vintage Table 1 levels, which is a weak volatility estimate for this noisy series.","actionRequested":"Use a longer same-series monthly-change sample where available, or explicitly label the 3-point sigma as a fallback heuristic and explain why the resulting +/-1.3 percentage point band is appropriate."},{"rubricItem":"prior_update_interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The compact step is mostly present, but the historical sample is too loosely described as the same advance variant even though the 2025 observation appears computed from Table 1 levels rather than taken as a first-print Table 2 advance value.","actionRequested":"Clarify whether the historical sample uses first-print advance values or current-vintage Census levels, and avoid calling it the same first-print variant unless verified."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Consider naming the release time in the resolver sentence: July 16, 2026 at 8:30 AM ET.","If possible, cite or preserve a stable release artifact instead of relying only on the rolling marts_current.pdf URL.","Tail scenarios are adequate, but could be made slightly more target-specific by quantifying what category moves would push the total below -1.0 or above 1.6."]}
